data.title: Bank asks for ID copy and self-disclosure form
data.summary: Muster Bank AG wrote on 18 December 2025 asking David Muster to update his customer data under the Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). He must send an ID copy and the completed self-disclosure form within 8 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: Banks in Germany must regularly verify customer data under the Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). Send the bank a copy of your valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen). The letter counts 8 working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) from the letter date; the app shows the resulting date. If you don't send the documents in time, the bank will block your securities account (Depot) for purchases until the matter is resolved. Check that the letter is genuine by contacting the bank through its known contact details.
